slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the toys produced, subject to the wood and steel limits and the logical conditions?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, directly covering the missing objective slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about trucks-vs-trains and boats-vs-airplanes relations but never inquired about any constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That there is no constraint requiring the number of boats to be less than or equal to the number of trains.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boats-to-trains relationship and silently omitted any such constraint from the confirmed understanding without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (objective) was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only remaining unresolved slot (H2) is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent confirmed the integer domain, the profit-maximization objective, and both logical constraints, resolving all P0/P1 slots before stopping; however, it never probed the P2 boats-versus-trains link and silently omitted it from the model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
